forum.title: STM32WL30XX PCB Antenna Design
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @uttambunny ,

Check the following resources include hardware designs guidelines for integrating and optimizing RF and antenna sections: [AN5923](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5923-how-to-optimize-the-rf-board-layout-for-stm32wl3x-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf), [AN5457,](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5457-rf-matching-network-design-guide-for-stm32wl-series-stmicroelectronics.pdf)[Data brief - Reference designs for STM32WL3x microcontrollers.](https://www.st.com/resource/en/data_brief/stdes-wl3c2sll.pdf)
forum.content_text:
I need support for the design of STM32WL30XX PCB Antenna. Are there reference designs available for the PCB antenna?

Specifications:

* Two layer board

* Output power 10dBm in the 868MHz band.
forum.author: uttambunny
